mainEntity.name: How much does MirrorSite AI cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: MirrorSite AI uses a token-based pricing system where 1 token = 1 UGX. New users get 500 free tokens. The minimum purchase is 15,000 tokens. You can pay using MTN Mobile Money or Airtel Money.

mainEntity.name: What AI models does MirrorSite AI support?

acceptedAnswer.text: MirrorSite AI supports multiple AI models including GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Google Gemini, Llama 3, and Mixtral through OpenRouter and Groq APIs.

Yes, you can clone any publicly accessible website. MirrorSite AI uses Firecrawl to scrape content and AI to generate code. However, respect copyright and intellectual property laws when using cloned designs.
